summary: Cell culture process in an aqueous medium; glucose and lactate currently measured off-line from samples with a delay that hinders prompt visibility of changes. Customer is exploring an in situ spectroscopy pilot to be checked against the existing laboratory measurements, and notes that the medium and cell population change during the run. No probe or calibration strategy has been selected yet.
